title: Reducedness is invariant under changing the scalar algebra by an algebra equivalence
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $A$ be a commutative $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], let $L$ and $M$ be fields equipped with $k$-algebra structures, and let $e:L\to M$ be a bijective $k$-algebra homomorphism. Then $A\otimes_k L$ is reduced if and only if $A\otimes_k M$ is reduced.

source.place: Tensor-product transport along an algebra equivalence, Tags 00CX and 05G3
